articles.title: We’ve never seen an Anthropic before
articles.content:
随着Anthropic在10月份即将上市的消息不断传出，这家AI公司开始吸引了一种不同的关注。SpaceX、Anthropic和OpenAI这三家公司极有可能成为美国资本市场史上最大的三次IPO。尽管OpenAI的收入增速在放缓，但Anthropic的年营收规模（ARR）仍在持续加速增长。

Anthropic上周末对投资者表示，其2025年7月底的ARR已达到650亿美元。而OpenAI在同期的ARR为400亿美元。虽然Anthropic的ARR计算中包括了市场伙伴的佣金（毛额），而OpenAI则扣除了微软的分成，导致Anthropic的ARR相对OpenAI可能略有高估，但无论如何，OpenAI在IPO前的增速下滑仍是一个重大事件。尤其当路由和代码包装器开始偏向中国开源模型以应对更低的token成本时，OpenAI在7月30日甚至将GPT-5.6系列API价格下调80%，这一举动显得颇为绝望。收入数据才是最真实的故事。

有趣的是，OpenAI目前约半数收入来自B2B业务，却面临中国开源模型的颠覆风险，而Anthropic似乎并未受到同样冲击。Anthropic在编码LLM领域的全球领先地位为其提供了定价优势。尽管Anthropic的Mythos模型被阻止使用，但其收入并未受到影响。正如我数月前预测的那样，Anthropic的营收已超越OpenAI，在OpenAI上市时，其营收可能是OpenAI的两倍。这简直难以置信，也将载入史册。

如果SpaceX的上市估值能作为参考，Anthropic应当瞄准2万亿美元的估值。SpaceX在尚未盈利且资本支出增长过快的情况下，以1.75万亿美元的天价上市。我预计Anthropic在2026年底的估值可能接近3万亿美元，因为我们从未见过像它这样的增长。

Anthropic的企业AI战略在2026年迎来拐点。今年第二季度，Anthropic的营收几乎是OpenAI的两倍，而OpenAI过去几年的增长速度已相当快速。历史上从未出现过像Anthropic这样的公司或AI创业公司。我们知道OpenAI的计算成本更高、财务状况更差，且在AI产品执行方面表现更差。随着市场竞争加剧，OpenAI将继续被压缩，我们很快就不会再将其视为前沿AI实验室。

Anthropic第二季度的营收暴涨至115亿美元，较去年同期的7.87亿美元增长了近15倍。ChatGPT虽然拥有8亿周活跃用户，但自市场份额跌破50%后，其市场份额持续快速下滑。作为主导生成式AI API的Anthropic，正在单独推动整个云计算行业的增长。

难以理解的是，Anthropic在数百亿美元的规模上仍能保持如此快的增长？这已实质性地改变了Google Cloud和AWS增长轨迹，这两家公司在Anthropic中持有大量股份并建立了合作伙伴关系。

Anthropic的ARR在2024年底和2024年初分别增长了2900%和64900%。Anthropic是2026年大科技财报的唯一主要推动力量。没有任何一家企业能在如此规模下实现14倍的增长。尽管OpenAI的营销把戏和SpaceX的疯狂自信（包括养老基金的投资）备受关注，但真正支撑这一轮AI热潮的只有三家公司：台积电、英伟达和Anthropic。这三家公司构成了过去三年生成式AI的核心。

Anthropic（黄色线条）的增长势头远超英伟达（绿色线条）和台积电（蓝色线条）。如果英伟达想要作为"AI银行"补贴计算能力（其贷款和供应商融资极其普遍），它应该让Anthropic的计算能力与OpenAI平起平坐。英伟达正在以激进的方式补贴Neo Clouds和计算成本，人为推高每个token的成本。

2026年中期，Anthropic的ARR每季度增加约90亿美元。Anthropic的ARR增长速度在最近几个季度是OpenAI的3到4倍，主要由企业采用和Claude Code等工具驱动。到OpenAI上市时，Anthropic将不再是可比较的公司。它将没有同级别的竞争对手，你明白这意味着什么吗？不是谷歌，不是OpenAI，不是DeepSeek或阿里巴巴，连接近都算不上。到2030年，Anthropic将实现AI霸主地位。
articles.summary:
As Anthropic’s IPO approaches likely in October, likely just 8 to 12 weeks from now - it’s beginning to attract a different kind of attention. SpaceX, Anthropic and OpenAI are likely to be the biggest trio of IPOs the U.S. public markets have ever seen. While OpenAI’s revenue growth continues to slow, Anthropic’s ARR continues to accelerate even at a very high scale.

Subscribe now

  • Anthropic told investors over the weekend that its annualized revenue run rate hit $65 billion at the end of July, 2025.

  • While OpenAI said its ARR has hit $40 billion.

Since Anthropic includes marketplace partner commissions (gross basis) in its reported ARR, whereas OpenAI reports metrics net of Microsoft’s cut, Anthropic’s relative ARR might be slightly overstated compared to OpenAI. But even while ChatGPT rushes to Ad markets, OpenAI’s slowdown is sort of a big deal pre-IPO. This at a time when routing and code wrappers favor Chinese open-weight models over OpenAI model usage due to cheaper token costs. OpenAI reduced API prices for the GPT-5.6 family on July 30, 2026, even going so far as to cut the cost of GPT-5.6 Lune by 80%. What an act of desperation. The revenue tells the real story.

Open-Source is disrupting OpenAI’s Revenue Growth

So ironically OpenAI that makes around half of its revenue from B2B vs. B2C, risks being disrupted by Open-source models out of China, even as Anthropic doesn’t feel the same bite. Anthropic has a premium advantage as the global leading frontier lab for coding LLMs.

While Anthropic even had its best Mythos model blocked, its revenue doesn’t seem to have been impacted yet: and, like I had predicted months ago, Anthropic has blown by OpenAI and might have 2x the revenue OpenAI does by the time OpenAI finally goes IPO. It’s hard to believe, and it’s one for the history books.

Share

If SpaceX’s IPO valuation is anything to go by, it (Anthropic) should be targeting a $2 Trillion valuation. SpaceX went public at an outrageous $1.75 trillion valuation while not being close to profitability and is accelerating Capex way too fast. I believe Anthropic could have close to a valuation of $3 Trillion by the end of 2026, because we’ve never seen growth like it has shown.

Historic Anthropic Revenue Growth in 2026

Anthropic's Enterprise AI strategy experienced an inflection point in 2026.

On a quarterly basis, Anthropic already nearly has double OpenAI’s revenue in Q2, and OpenAI has been accelerating fast the last few years. We’ve essentially never seen a company or an AI startup like Anthropic, in history. We know that OpenAI has higher compute costs, has worse financials and executes much more poorly on AI product. As the market becomes more competitive, it will continue to be squeezed. We simply won’t consider it a frontier lab for very much longer.

Anthropic's revenue for the second quarter surged to $11.5 billion, up from $787 million a year ago. It's been growing at an incredibly fast pace.

It doesn’t matter that ChatGPT has 800 million “weekly” active users, ever since its marketshare dropped below 50% and it’s market share continues to rapidly decline. Anthropic’s success as the dominant Generative AI API, is accelerating the entire Cloud computing industry by itself.

So how much has Anthropic’s Revenue increased in the last two years?

It’s hard to understand how growth could continue even at this scale (of the tens of billions) ? It’s meaningfully changed the trajectory of Google Cloud and AWS growth who both have significant equity (and partnerships) in the AI startup.

Anthropic's ARR has increased between 2,900% (from year-end 2024) and 64,900% (from start-of-year 2024).

Anthropic is thus the single primary tailwind for BigTech Earnings in 2026. Nobody grows 14x as this scale, nobody. For all the marketing gimmicks of OpenAI and insane confidence in SpaceX (including sadly some Pension funds), its three companies carrying the entire AI boom: TSMC, Nvidia and Anthropic. These companies are the backbone of what we call Generative AI of the last three years.

  • Yellow line is Anthropic 🟡

  • Green line is Nvidia 🟢

  • Blue line is TSMC 🔵

If Nvidia wants to subsidize compute as the “Bank of AI” (so prolific is it in circular and vendor financing), it should enable Anthropic to have compute parity with OpenAI. Nvidia is subsidizing Neo Clouds and the costs of compute at radical levels artificially inflating the value of the cost per token.

Anthropic is increasing ARR around $9 Billion per quarter in mid 2026. Anthropic's Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) has been growing roughly 3x to 4x faster than OpenAI's over recent quarters, driven largely by enterprise adoption and tooling like Claude Code. By the time OpenAI goes IPO, Anthropic won’t be a comparable company. It won’t have a peer competitor, do you understand what that means? Not Google, not OpenAI, not DeepSeek or Alibaba, not even close. By 2030, Anthropic will have achieved AI Supremacy.

OpenAI really is Slowing
